name: container-mcp
description: Manage the Linux containers of Apple's container tool on this Mac through a local MCP server with a fixed security policy, plus skills for running containers and building images.

write_tools_enabled.title: Allow write tools
write_tools_enabled.description: Let Claude create, start, stop, exec into, build and delete containers. Off: Claude can only look.

read_only_folders.title: Folders containers may read
read_only_folders.description: Absolute paths. Containers may mount these folders, or folders inside them, read-only. Paths may not contain commas.

writable_folders.title: Folders containers may change
writable_folders.description: Absolute paths. Mounts inside these may be read-write when Claude asks for it.

registries.title: Registries images may come from
registries.description: Bare domains, such as docker.io and ghcr.io.

default_cpus.title: Default CPUs per container
default_cpus.description: Used when Claude does not ask for a number.

default_memory_mib.title: Default memory per container (MiB)
default_memory_mib.description: Used when Claude does not ask for an amount.

log_max_lines.title: Maximum log lines
log_max_lines.description: The most lines one log call returns.

log_max_bytes.title: Maximum log bytes
log_max_bytes.description: The most bytes one log call returns.

exec_timeout_seconds.title: Command timeout (seconds)
exec_timeout_seconds.description: A command run in a container is killed after this.

exec_max_output_bytes.title: Command output limit (bytes)
exec_max_output_bytes.description: The most output one command returns.

pull_timeout_seconds.title: Image download timeout (seconds)
pull_timeout_seconds.description: A pull is abandoned after this.

build_timeout_seconds.title: Image build timeout (seconds)
build_timeout_seconds.description: A build is abandoned after this.

protected_containers.title: Containers Claude must never touch
protected_containers.description: Container names. Claude can see that they exist but cannot start, stop, run commands in, read, or delete them. Every other container can be managed.
